unmappedReports: Estimated solar power (1 W). `pv-power-forecast` exists but means 'Solar Expected' from the weather-forecast driver — a modelled future value. This is a present-tense estimate derived from a measured reference cell. Mapping one onto the other would silently merge two different kinds of claim, so it is left unmapped rather than forced., Estimated daily yield (1 Wh). `pv-energy-today` exists but every current producer of it reports *measured* production. This device reports what the array should have made. Same objection, deliberately not mapped., Sensor cell temperature versus ambient. The contract has one `temperature`; a PV reference cell in the sun reads far above air temperature, and there is no way to label which one a reading is., Stored trends — irradiance, estimated power and temperature at 31 days — and stored history — max daily irradiance, min/max daily estimated solar power, min/max daily temperature, daily estimated yield, at 730 days. Two years of daily extremes is a genuinely useful record for sizing a cabin array and the contract has no shape for it, which is the same conclusion docs/catalog/ve-direct.md reached about MPPT registers 0x1050–0x106E., Internal battery state. A self-powered sensor that runs >2 years in no light and >2 months in very low light will eventually go flat, and there is no metric for 'the sensor's own battery'. Its silence is indistinguishable from nightfall.
